decision: ran four design sketches in parallel (opus, fable, sonnet, haiku) from the same brief and a six-point rubric
why: the data model and sync model are the hard-to-undo part; comparing whole shapes beats committing to the first one

decision: based the design on the fable sketch; added the opus sketch's receipt editor, member merge and paging, and the haiku sketch's hashed invite code
why: cross-judge scored fable 27, opus 25; my own read favoured opus for UX but the judge's point holds: re-deriving receipt shares breaks when a member is archived (computeSplit drops absent people, split.ts:40)

decision: each expense stores who owes what (owed cents), worked out once at save
why: phones on different app versions must agree on old balances; same reasoning as freezing the exchange rate

decision: hand-rolled typed routes, no router library
why: flat routes, no loaders; an exhaustive switch catches a missing page at typecheck

decision: invite code in the URL fragment, server stores only its sha256
why: fragment never reaches server logs; a leaked database row can't open a group

decision: made Split installable and start offline: manifest, icons, service worker, fonts bundled locally; updates apply only when the app is in the background
why: a reload mid-tap would drop a half-typed expense; drafts and pending changes are in localStorage so a background reload loses nothing
evidence: branch gl/pwa cf48f42; Chromium installability errors [], offline reload rendered with fonts

decision: made the receipt wizard reusable inside a group: the workspace store is now created per draft key, and a ReceiptEditor runs receipt, items, summary with a save slot
why: a group receipt must never overwrite the quick split's draft

decision: / is now a home screen; the existing wizard moved to /split with its draft kept
why: home has to list groups; existing drafts stay at the same storage keys

decision: posting returns nothing for an expense with no positive share; ops that change nothing make no activity row
why: the types say an expense owes someone; an empty activity row helps nobody
